clips.title: The story
paras: Gazrog at the Crossroads sends you after payroll silver stolen by raptors. Rumors of their cunning lead you south of Ratchet, into the Raptor Grounds. The garrison needs its wages back.

Gazrog needs the Crossroads guards paid, and the raptors have taken their wages. You are sent to recover the stolen coin, not simply punish the beasts. When raptors ambushed the payroll shipment, Gazrog first sought vengeance. But killing the pack would not restore the missing money. The Horde must learn how the raptors carried off heavy crates of coin, and where they took them.

Scouts found a raptor nest between two craggy peaks, south of Ratchet and northwest of Northwatch Hold. The creatures dragged the intact lockbox into their territory, where they guard it alongside eggs and fresh kills. Tales of raptor cunning and hoarding now seem true to Gazrog. Ordinary beasts rarely stash metallic valuables.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You may have killed the raptors, but the silver they stole must be recovered! I have reports that the raptors have a large grouping of nests south of Ratchet, known as the Raptor Grounds. It is likely that they brought our stolen silver there.
Go to this raptor haven and search for the stolen silver. When you find it, return it to me.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Aha! So the raptors did hide the silver at their lair. It's hard to believe these beasts would have the desire for silver. Perhaps the stories of their intelligence are not as far from the mark as I thought!
Thank you, friend. Take this as a reward for your service to us, and know that the guards of the crossroads owe their next month's pay to you.
